title: Understanding the Plot
text: The violin plot is used to visualize the distribution of a numeric variable for different categories. Here, you want to visualize the distribution of $$`ed_{hours}`$$ for each combination of `role` and $$`is_{graduating}`$$. Think about which variable should be on the y-axis to show this distribution.

title: Choosing the Correct Variable for y-axis
text: Which variable should be on the y-axis to show the distribution of hours spent resolving questions?
